title: Graduated State Income Tax (3.7%-8.4%; lowers taxes <$510.8k)
tabor_and_fund_channel: 100% TABOR-exempt in Colorado Future's Account; supplements K-12, health care (Medicaid) & early childhood.
csu_budget_implication: Indirectly brightens Higher Ed General Fund outlook by absorbing K-12 and Medicaid growth that crowded out FFS/COF appropriations (+1% state = ~$2.1M to CSU); earmarked outside E&G.

title: Keep & Spend TABOR Surplus for K-12 & Children's Programs
tabor_and_fund_channel: Raises TABOR cap up to $4.6B above baseline; first 10 yrs split between K-12 teacher pay/CTE, children's programs & senior property-tax backfill.
csu_budget_implication: Eases long-term K-12 budget pressure, though FY27 & FY28 each shift $153.1M from General Government Purposes into the Children's Account; Prop 137 reduces retained TABOR dollars.

title: Direct Sporting-Goods Sales Tax Revenue to Conservation & Wildfire
tabor_and_fund_channel: TABOR-exempt transfer from General Fund / TABOR surplus; up to $36.5M (FY28) and $42.8M (FY29) allocated to CSU's Colorado State Forest Service (CSFS).
csu_budget_implication: Major dedicated expansion for wildfire mitigation at CSU's CSFS Non-E&G state agency; legally restricted outside Fort Collins Resident Instruction E&G operations.

title: Cap Individual & Corporate Income Tax Rate at 4.4%
tabor_and_fund_channel: Designed as conflicting countermeasure to cap income tax at 4.4% and block Amendment 87's upper brackets.
csu_budget_implication: Rejection clears legal path for Amendment 87 implementation without a 4.4% statutory rate ceiling.

title: Increase Criminal Penalties for Fentanyl Crimes
tabor_and_fund_channel: Unfunded state court, public defender & prison mandates drawn from the State General Fund.
csu_budget_implication: Blue Book notes General Fund prison costs compete directly against Health Care, K-12, and Higher Education.

title: Biological Sex Designations for School & Collegiate Sports
tabor_and_fund_channel: Requires institutional policy updates funded from student fees, tuition, or athletics revenue.
csu_budget_implication: Administrative compliance duty for public athletics and intramural departments without direct General Fund support.
